request.name: Amber morning square
request.prompt: A photorealistic product film. An unbranded amber glass fragrance bottle with a simple matte black cap stands on pale limestone beside a few fresh green leaves. Soft warm window light shines through the amber glass. A leaf shadow gently moves across the stone in a light breeze; the bottle stays still. Clear coherent glass edges and realistic reflections. No text, labels, logos or people. A single continuous locked-off macro shot, no camera shake. Quiet natural room ambience with a faint rustle of leaves. No speech or music.
